findings.explanation: Toys/premium commission rate is 17%. Expected fee = round(5114.31*0.17) = -869.43, giving expected net 4222.98. Observed settlement row ST-0300021 charged fee -969.16 (net 4123.25), an excess commission of 99.73 with no low-ticket fee or shipping explanation (shipping -21.90 matches standard weight class in both).

Home/premium commission rate is 17%. Expected fee = round(2006.08*0.17) = -341.03, giving expected net 1625.15. Observed settlement row ST-0300006 charged fee -400.21 (net 1565.97), an excess commission of 59.18 (effective rate ~19.95% instead of contracted 17%); shipping -39.90 for heavy weight class matches in both.

Order gross 64.74 (electronics/premium, low-ticket fee applies) should settle once for net 48.13 (fee -16.61). Two full payment rows were posted (ST-0300026 and ST-0300057), each with identical gross 64.74 and fee -16.61, i.e. the same commission charged twice rather than a legitimate split (which would carry fees only on the first row and unfee'd remaining gross on the second). Summed observed net 96.26 vs expected 48.13 - the order was paid out twice.

Order MLB-030048 (fashion/classic, gross 42.15, delivered) has zero settlement rows. Expected a payment row with fee -11.73 (13% commission + 6.25 low-ticket fee since unit_price 42.15 < 79.00) and net 30.42. No shipping applies since gross < 79.00. Seller was never paid for this delivered order.

Settlement row ST-0400068 (payment, gross=214.15, fee=-27.84, net=186.31) references order MLB-049648, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding order to justify this payout, so it is an orphan settlement row with no expected counterpart (expected net = 0.00 vs observed net = 186.31).

Order MLB-040050 is weight_class 'heavy', so per the fee rules the seller shipping deduction should be 39.90 (expected net = 3043.08 - 517.32 - 39.90 = 2485.86). The settlement row ST-0400057 instead deducted 61.80 in shipping (net = 2463.96), which equals 21.90 + 39.90 - i.e. both the standard and heavy shipping rates were charged. This overcharged the seller by 21.90 (2485.86 - 2463.96 = 21.90).

Order MLB-040060 is weight_class 'standard', so the correct seller shipping deduction is 21.90 (expected net = 882.88 - 88.29 - 21.90 = 772.69). The settlement row ST-0400067 deducted 39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead, giving net = 754.69, an overcharge of 18.00 (772.69 - 754.69 = 18.00).

Order is fully refunded (gross 1211.46, refund 1211.46). Expected two settlement lines: payment net 1026.18 and refund net -1066.08 (refund gross -1211.46, fee +145.38 returned), giving expected total net -39.90. Only the payment row (net 1026.18) appears on the statement; the refund row is missing entirely.

Delivered order with gross 909.36 (home, premium, heavy) has zero settlement rows. Expected payment row: fee -154.59 (17% commission), shipping -39.90, net 714.87. No rows were ever settled to the seller.

Order status is cancelled (books, premium, gross 363.23), which per rules should have NO settlement rows at all. A payment row was nonetheless settled: gross 363.23, fee -54.48, ship -21.90, net 286.85.

Full refund order (fashion, classic, gross 38.40, low-ticket fee applies, commission 11.24). Expected refund row: gross -38.40, fee +11.24 (commission returned), net -27.16, giving expected order total net 0.00. Observed refund row instead shows fee 0.00, net -38.40, so the commission was never returned to the seller, making the observed order total net -11.24.

Paid order (toys, premium, gross 434.84) should be charged 17% commission = 73.92 (rounded), giving expected fee -73.92 and net 339.02 (shipping -21.90 correct). Observed fee is -82.62 (~19% rate, not matching any category/listing tier), yielding observed net 330.32 - an overcharge of 8.70.

Order is partially_refunded (refund=1158.25 on gross=1930.41, i.e. 60%). Per rules, the refund row should return commission proportionally: fee=+round_half_up(308.87*0.60)=+185.32, giving refund net=-972.93 and total net=608.71. Observed refund row has fee=0.00, giving refund net=-1158.25 and total net=423.39. The commission portion (185.32) was never returned to the seller.

Order MLB-060087 (paid, fashion/premium, gross=236.59) has zero settlement rows despite being paid. Expected payment row: gross=236.59, fee=-42.59, ship=-21.90, net=172.10. Observed net=0.00 - the payment was never settled.

Order MLB-060091 (books/classic, gross=67.18) has two payment rows, each carrying the full gross=67.18 and full fee=-19.22 (net=47.96 each), totaling net=95.92. A legitimate split settlement would carry fees only on the first row and remaining gross with no fees on the second; here the entire payment was duplicated verbatim. Expected net total=47.96, observed=95.92, an excess of 47.96 paid to the seller.

Order MLB-060070 (electronics/classic, gross=131.36, unit=65.68<79 so low-ticket fee applies). Expected fee = commission 11%*131.36=14.45 + low-ticket 6.25*2=12.50 = -26.95. Observed fee=-29.41, an overcharge of 2.46.
Order MLB-060070 has weight_class='standard', so expected shipping deduction is -21.90. Observed shipping deduction is -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate), an overcharge of 18.00.

Order MLB-060094 (toys/classic, gross=308.70, weight_class='standard') should be charged shipping of -21.90. Fee is correct (-37.04, matching 12% commission with no low-ticket surcharge since unit=308.70>=79). Observed shipping deduction is -39.90 (heavy rate), overcharging the seller by 18.00, matching the observed net shortfall of 249.76-231.76=18.00.

Order MLB-060038 (electronics/premium, gross=108.54, unit=36.18<79 so low-ticket fee applies). Expected fee = commission 16%*108.54=17.37 + low-ticket 6.25*3=18.75 = -36.12. Observed fee=-38.05, an overcharge of 1.93 (shipping deduction of -21.90 is correct).

Settlement row ST-0700194 (payment, gross=662.56, fee=-86.13, net=576.43) references order MLB-079870 which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding sale can justify this settlement.

Order is 'delivered', electronics/classic, gross=113.30, standard shipping. Expected settlement: commission -12.46 (11% of 113.30), shipping -21.90, net=78.94. No settlement rows exist at all for this order (observed net=0.00).
Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), so per rule 6 it must have NO settlement rows. However a payment row ST-0700195 exists with gross=77.33, fee=-19.40, net=57.93.

Order is 'partially_refunded' with refund_amount=45.76. Expected two lines: payment (net=60.10) plus refund (gross=-45.76, fee=+9.70, net=-36.06), for an expected total net of 24.04. Only the payment row (net=60.10) is present; the refund row was never settled, leaving the seller overpaid by 36.06 (60.10 observed vs 24.04 expected).

Order weight_class is 'heavy', so expected shipping deduction is -39.90 (commission -193.20 on gross 1756.35 at 11%, expected net=1523.25). Observed row ST-0700144 deducted shipping of -61.80 (= 39.90+21.90, i.e. both heavy and standard shipping charged), producing observed net=1501.35, a shortfall of 21.90 versus expected.

Order is toys/premium, gross=244.74, unit_price=122.37 (no low-ticket fee). Expected commission = round(244.74*0.17) = 41.61, expected net = 181.23 (with -21.90 standard shipping). Observed fee charged was -45.99, 4.38 higher than the correct 41.61, producing observed net=176.85 instead of 181.23.

Order gross 2602.59 (electronics, classic, heavy) generates one expected payment row with fee -286.28 and shipping -39.90, net 2276.41. The settlement statement shows TWO identical payment rows (ST-0800221 and ST-0800233), each with the same full gross, fee and shipping, summing to net 4552.82 - double the expected amount. This is not a legitimate split (a split carries fees only on the first row); it's a straight duplicate of the same payment.

Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), so per rule 6 it should have NO settlement rows and expected net is 0.00. However settlement row ST-0800232 shows a full payment of gross 431.24, fee -73.31, shipping -21.90, net 336.03 was settled to the seller.

Order is 'delivered', gross 130.24 (fashion, classic, unit_price<79 triggers low-ticket fee), expected payment row: fee -29.43, shipping -21.90, net 78.91. No settlement rows exist for this order at all (0 rows found).

Order partially refunded 344.84 of gross 1149.47 (toys, classic, 12% commission). Expected refund row: gross -344.84, fee +41.38 (commission returned = round(137.94*30%)), net -303.46. Observed refund row ST-0800023 has fee 0.00 and net -344.84, i.e. the commission credit of 41.38 was never returned to the seller. Total order net observed 644.79 vs expected 686.17 (diff 41.38).

Order is heavy weight_class, gross 554.35 >=79, so seller should be charged the heavy shipping fee of 39.90. Settlement row ST-0800078 deducts shipping of 61.80 instead (=39.90+21.90, i.e. both standard and heavy rates summed). Fee/commission matches expected (-88.70), only shipping is wrong, causing net 403.85 vs expected 425.75 (diff 21.90).

Order is fashion/premium, gross 734.75, contractual commission rate 18% => expected fee -132.26 (734.75*0.18=132.255->132.26). Settlement row ST-0800128 charged fee -146.51, i.e. an effective rate of ~19.94%, 14.25 more than the contractual fee. Net observed 566.34 vs expected 580.59.

Order is electronics/classic, gross 4219.64, contractual commission rate 11% => expected fee -464.16 (4219.64*0.11=464.1604->464.16). Settlement row ST-0800098 charged fee -464.62, 0.46 more than contractual, net observed 3715.12 vs expected 3715.58. This exceeds the 0.02 rounding tolerance.

Order status is 'refunded' (full refund of gross 3246.00) but only the original payment row (net 2686.74) exists on the statement; the required refund row (expected gross -3246.00, fee +519.36, net -2726.64) is missing. Expected order total net = -39.90, observed = 2686.74.

Order gross 521.19 (fashion/premium, single installment purchase, not a legitimate split since fees appear on BOTH rows) was settled twice: two payment rows each gross 521.19/fee -93.81/ship -21.90/net 405.48, summing to net 810.96 vs expected single-payment net of 405.48.
Settlement row ST-0900298 (gross 425.56, fee -55.32, net 370.24) references order MLB-099824, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding order to justify this payout.
Fashion/classic order, commission rate 13%, gross 1594.57 -> expected commission = round(1594.57*0.13) = 207.29. Observed payment row charged fee -251.14, an overcharge of 43.85 (251.14-207.29).

Order fully refunded (gross 1594.57). Per rules the refund row must return the commission (+207.29 at the 13% rate) with gross -1594.57. Observed refund row shows fee 0.00 and net -1594.57, i.e. no commission was credited back to the seller at all.

Order MLB-090238 (status 'paid', gross 229.44, home/classic, unit price 76.48<79 so low-ticket fee applies) has zero settlement rows. Expected payment: gross 229.44, fee -46.28 (commission 27.53 + low-ticket 3*6.25=18.75), ship -21.90, net 161.26. Observed net = 0.00.

Home/premium order, commission rate 17%, gross 2303.40 -> expected commission = round(2303.40*0.17) = 391.58. Observed payment row charged fee -442.95, an overcharge of 51.37 (442.95-391.58). Shipping (heavy, 39.90) matches expected.

Order MLB-090243 is weight_class 'standard' with gross 2534.22 (>=79), so seller-paid shipping should be 21.90. The settlement instead deducted the 'heavy' rate of 39.90, an overcharge of 18.00. Commission fee (-456.16) was correct.

Settlement row ST-1000340 (gross 661.91, fee -86.05, net 575.86) references order MLB-109378 which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding sale to justify this payout.

Order is status=paid, gross 419.68, home/classic, heavy shipping. Expected settlement: commission -50.36 (12%), shipping -39.90, net 329.42. No settlement rows exist at all for this order (observed net 0.00).
Order status is cancelled, which per rules must have NO settlement rows. However a payment row (ST-1000339) was settled: gross 52.58, fee -11.51, net 41.07.

Order weight_class is 'standard' so shipping should be 21.90, giving expected net 336.81 (gross 432.18, fee -73.47, ship -21.90). Settlement instead deducted the heavy rate of 39.90, producing observed net 318.81 (fee -73.47 matches, but ship -39.90). Difference of 18.00 = 39.90-21.90.

Observed refund row ST-1000066 has fee 0.00, net -74.56, so the commission was never returned. Order total observed net -17.43 vs expected 0.00.

Fashion/premium listing, gross 406.02, correct commission rate 18% => expected fee -73.08 (round_half_up(406.02*0.18)=73.08), expected net 311.04 with shipping -21.90. Settlement row ST-1000185 charged fee -84.49 instead, producing observed net 299.63. Overcharge of 11.41.

Only the original payment row (net 8.37) is present; no refund row was ever settled, leaving the buyer's refund unprocessed on the statement.

Books/premium listing, gross 2380.47, correct commission rate 15% => expected fee -357.07 (round_half_up(2380.47*0.15)), expected net 2001.50 with shipping -21.90. Settlement row ST-1000205 charged fee -357.75 instead, producing observed net 2000.82. Overcharge of 0.68 (above the 0.02 rounding tolerance).

Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled-before-payment orders must have zero settlement rows per rule #6), yet settlement row ST-1100398 shows a full payment: gross 1465.32, fee -175.84, ship -39.90, net 1249.58. Expected net was 0.00.

Order is 'paid' (toys, classic, gross 811.30) with expected net settlement of 692.04 (11% commission... actually 12% toys classic = 97.36 commission, ship 21.90), but zero settlement rows exist for this order.
